system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hello, bonjour. I need help please. I want to cancel all my upcoming flights.

My name is Amelia Davis, and my user id is amelia_davis_8890.

I do not know the reservation numbers, désolée. Can you look them up from my account? Even if some flights are not refundable, I still want to cancel them so another person can use the seat.

I found these reservations on your account and checked whether they appear to be upcoming/cancellable:

Eligible for self-service cancellation:
- 8C8K4E — BOS to DEN on 2024-05-24, business, 2 passengers, insurance: yes
- UDMOP1 — upcoming basic economy reservation on 2024-05-28 to 2024-05-29, 1 passenger, insurance: no
- XAZ3C0 — ATL to CLT on 2024-05-27, basic economy, 2 passengers, insurance: no
- LU15PA — SFO to SFO on 2024-05-23, business, 2 passengers, insurance: no
- MSJ4OA — DFW to SFO on 2024-05-22, economy, 3 passengers, insurance: yes
- 4XGCCM — round trip on 2024-05-03 to 2024-05-04, business, 1 passenger; first checked flight is cancelled

Not eligible for self-service cancellation:
- I6M8JQ — 2024-05-09 flight has already been flown

Before I cancel anything, I need the cancellation reason for the reservations you want cancelled. Please reply with one reason for all eligible reservations, or list reasons by reservation:
- change of plan
- airline cancelled flight
- other reasons

If you want, you can simply reply like:
- “change of plan for 8C8K4E, UDMOP1, XAZ3C0, LU15PA, MSJ4OA”
- “airline cancelled flight for 4XGCCM”

After you give the reason(s), I will list the cancellations and ask for your final yes before proceeding.

For I6M8JQ, because part of the trip has already been flown, I cannot cancel it here. If you want help with that one, I can transfer you to a human agent.

Yes, merci.

Please use:
- change of plan for 8C8K4E, UDMOP1, XAZ3C0, LU15PA, MSJ4OA
- airline cancelled flight for 4XGCCM

Please cancel all of those eligible reservations. Even if some are non-refundable, c’est bon, I still want to proceed.

Please confirm these cancellations:

- 8C8K4E — reason: change of plan
- UDMOP1 — reason: change of plan
- XAZ3C0 — reason: change of plan
- LU15PA — reason: change of plan
- MSJ4OA — reason: change of plan
- 4XGCCM — reason: airline cancelled flight

Notes:
- Refund eligibility is based on the reservation rules. If eligible, refunds will go back to the original payment method(s) within 5 to 7 business days.
- I6M8JQ is not included because part of that trip has already been flown.

Reply yes to proceed with cancelling these 6 reservations.

Yes, please proceed and cancel these 6 reservations.

I understand about the refunds and that I6M8JQ is not included. Merci beaucoup.
